# Reflex

> Reflex makes AI coding agents prod-safe for infra teams. It is an open-source (MIT) pre-execution risk gate and prompt injection guard for Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, pi, oh-my-pi and Hermes. It adds what the agents' built-in permission rules lack: terraform AI agent guardrails (a plan-aware apply gate that reads a saved plan and denies deletes and replaces, off by default and needing a provider plugin cache), awareness of the AWS profile, kube context, Terraform workspace and production paths, one team policy in `.reflex/` across agents, change freezes, a SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audit export with a decision webhook, and fail-closed hooks. Through each agent's hooks it decides for every shell command whether it runs, needs a human's approval, or is blocked, and it scans tool results (web pages, MCP results, files from other projects, network command output) for prompt injection. Decisions come from local deterministic rules first, then from the engine you choose: `local` (no key, no network), TypeSafe Jev (a hosted System One model answering typed questions, turned into a decision by an editable policy file) or Laya (experimental, on 127.0.0.1). An autonomous profile adds a stronger model (System 2) and an asynchronous human approval queue.

In Claude Code install it as a plugin: `/plugin marketplace add ursuciprian/reflex`, then `/plugin install reflex@reflex`. Codex CLI: `codex plugin marketplace add ursuciprian/reflex`, then `codex plugin add reflex@reflex`. opencode: `{"plugin": ["@ursuciprian/reflex"]}` in `opencode.json`. Every agent: `npx @ursuciprian/reflex setup` or `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ursuciprian/reflex/main/install.sh | bash`. Requires Node.js 18+ on macOS or Linux, including WSL. New installs use the local engine in shadow mode: deterministic rules block, everything else is logged. Reflex gates shell commands and subagent spawns only; file edits and MCP tool calls go through each agent's own permissions. It supplements a sandbox and least-privilege credentials. Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cowork and other MCP hosts can run `reflex mcp`, an MCP server for AI agent safety with read-only, advisory tools (`reflex_check`, `reflex_scan`, `reflex_status`, `reflex_audit`, `reflex_explain`); hooks enforce, the MCP server only advises.

npm package: `@ursuciprian/reflex`. Repository: https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex. Documentation website: https://ursuciprian.github.io/reflex/

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#readme): prod-safe AI coding agents for infra teams: what Reflex adds to built-in agent permissions, install, usage, features, measured results and limits
- [In one minute](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#in-one-minute): a seven-point summary of what Reflex does and does not do
- [Install](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#install): Claude Code plugin, Codex CLI plugin, opencode plugin, or a one-line install with npx, pnpm dlx, bunx, yarn dlx or curl
- [How a command is decided](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#how-a-command-is-decided): read-only list, rules, fast lane, then the engine and the policy; the six Jev questions
- [Real-world scenarios, with outputs](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#real-world-scenarios-with-outputs): unedited decisions for terraform apply in prod, kubectl delete, curl piped to bash, a prompt injection in a README
- [Measured results](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#measured-results): golden-set numbers for the tool gate, the injection guard, the escalation ladder, System 2 cost and Jev vs Laya
- [Replay on a real week](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#replay-what-it-would-have-done-on-a-real-week): what the gate would have done with 13,743 Claude Code and 700 Codex commands
- [Also included](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#also-included): runaway guard, replay, suggest, MCP server, model routing, context layer, tool router, Laya
- [Compared with other AI coding agent guardrails](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#compared-with-other-ai-coding-agent-guardrails): Claude Code permission rules, --dangerously-skip-permissions, devcontainers, the Codex sandbox, abide, LLM-as-judge hooks, and a capability table for plan-aware terraform, change freeze, audit and cross-agent policy
- [Supported agents](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#supported-agents-claude-code-hooks-codex-hooks-and-more): which hook each agent uses and how an ask is shown
- [Cost and latency](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#cost-and-latency): token use, timing and price assumptions per engine
- [Limits](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex#limits): what Reflex does not cover
- [FAQ](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): 28 questions with direct answers, from "how do I stop Claude Code from running dangerous commands" to uninstalling
- [Setup](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md): TypeSafe key, install options, per-agent hooks, enforce mode, calibrated allow, the autonomous profile, configuration variables, uninstall
- [Guide](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): design, testing, rollout, data handling, safety properties, injection guard, autonomous agents, Laya

## Key topics

- [Data handling](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#data-handling): exactly what leaves the machine with each engine, and redaction
- [Safety properties and limits](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#safety-properties-and-limits): fallbacks, failure modes and what is out of scope
- [Injection guard](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#injection-guard): which tool results are scanned, detectors, what each agent can do with a finding
- [Plan-aware terraform gate](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#plan-aware-terraform-gate-stop-ai-agents-from-destroying-infrastructure): prevent AI agent terraform destroy: judging terraform apply by its saved plan (terraform show -json), denying destroys and replaces, the plugin cache requirement, an optional kubectl AI agent guardrail with kubectl diff
- [OpenTofu and Terragrunt](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#opentofu-and-terragrunt): OpenTofu AI agent plan gate (tofu show -json), Terragrunt guardrails for run-all apply and destroy
- [helm guardrails for AI agents](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#helm-guardrails-for-ai-agents): helm uninstall AI agent guardrail, rollback and production upgrades, optional helm diff
- [Team policy](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#team-policy-share-reflex-rules-across-a-repo): one committed `.reflex/policy.json` for Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, pi and Hermes; it only tightens, and its fast lane and webhook need `reflex trust .`
- [Change freeze](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#change-freeze-for-ai-coding-agents): deploy freezes and change windows for AI coding agents
- [Audit log](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#audit-log-for-ai-agent-commands-soc-2): SOC 2 AI agent audit: `reflex audit` csv, json or jsonl export and the decision webhook
- [Reflex fails closed](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#reflex-fails-closed): what each agent gets when a hook crashes
- [Autonomous agents](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#autonomous-agents): System 2 backends, the always-human class, the approval queue, task envelopes, checkpoints
- [Suggest: fewer permission prompts](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#suggest-fewer-permission-prompts): `reflex suggest` proposes project-scoped fast-lane entries for repeated build, test and lint commands
- [Calibrated allow](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#calibrated-allow): letting clearly safe commands skip the agent's permission prompt
- [Laya (local System 1)](https://github.com/ursuciprian/reflex/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md#laya-local-system-1): the experimental local engine and how it measured against Jev
